title: Counterpoint: Global PC shipments were down 21% in Q3
description: A new Counterpoint Research report revealed that global PC shipments totaled 57 million units during the July-September period (Q3). The figure represents a 21% decline compared to the same time last year, with all major brands experiencing dwindling shipments. The main reason behind the decline lies in rising component costs, with DRAM and NAND memory chips being the main contributing factors. These components, in turn, made laptops more expensive, which naturally led to lowered demand as users put off replacements and purchases. Looking at the global PC market share, Lenovo...

title: Apple celebrates iPod's 25th anniversary with fun easter egg
description: The original iPod turns 25 today and Apple decided to celebrate the milestone with a fun easter egg on the Apple Music website. Going to music.apple.com/us/ipod will reveal a fully functional digital version of the first-gen music player complete with the iconic scroll wheel and stacked with a big selection of 90-second sample songs from the era. It’s a fun way to experience one of the most iconic Apple devices ever. The original iPod was announced on October 23, 2001 and hit store shelves on November 10 of that year. It was available in 5GB and 10GB storage trims and connected to Mac...

title: Oura sues Ultrahuman in the US once again, threatening the new Ring Pro
description: Last year, the Finnish company Oura sued the India-based Ultrahuman in the US over patent infringement. Oura argued that Ultrahuman violated a patent, and the court found the latter guilty. Subsequently, the Ultrahuman Ring Air was pulled out of the market. Ultrahuman then reworked and launched the Ring Pro in the US, but Oura hit the smart ring manufacturer with another lawsuit, now citing two patents related to the design and internal components. Oura is seeking monetary damages and is once again asking the court to block all Ring Pro sales in the US. The case is being carried out...

description: vivo has already confirmed that the Y600 will launch in China on October 30, with pre-orders opening on October 26. title: Huawei Enjoy 100 series launch date confirmed, pre-orders open
description: The Huawei Enjoy 100 series now has a launch date. Huawei has announced that the lineup will be unveiled on October 28 at 14:30 local time in China, and pre-orders have already opened today through Huawei's online store, authorized e-commerce partners, and retail stores. The official teaser poster shows three phones in blue, white, and orange, each with a different camera design. title: Here's your first look at Samsung's upcoming Galaxy Fit4
description: Samsung is expected to launch a successor to its affordable Galaxy Fit3 fitness tracker soon. While we await an official announcement, leaked renders of the alleged Galaxy Fit4 have surfaced online, offering a first look at its design and color options. The leaked renders and videos suggest that the Galaxy Fit4 could look almost identical to its predecessor. The upcoming fitness tracker appears to retain the same rectangular display with rounded corners, while the rear features a familiar sensor layout. title: iPhone Duo is now shipping
description: After being on pre-order for a whole week, the iPhone Duo is now officially available across 70 countries and regions. Those who placed their pre-orders on time last week will hopefully be getting their devices today and Apple will have limited supplies of Duo units at its physical stores too. Users who are currently trying to secure a Duo online are in for a long wait, with shipments being pushed to January as per the official Apple Store. title: Huawei Pura 90 Plus to launch next week, design and color options revealed
description: Huawei has officially confirmed the Pura 90 Plus and opened pre-orders for the phone in China. The company has also revealed its design, color options, and storage configurations. The Huawei Pura 90 Plus will go on sale in China on October 28. While the company has yet to reveal the phone’s specifications, it has given us a first look at its design. Based on images shared on Huawei’s official online store, the Pura 90 Plus appears to feature curved sides, unlike the flat frame found on the other Pura 90 series models. title: Apple is testing iPhone Duo 2 prototype with this key upgrade
description: The iPhone Duo is now slowly making its way to users who placed their pre-orders last week and the first round of reviews are already out. The consensus is that it suffers from typical first-gen product shortcomings and most reviewers are not too fond of the Touch ID sensor. Depending on the orientation that you’re holding the device, it can be hard to reach and it also requires you to hold your finger on the sensor to fully unlock the phone. title: WhatsApp expands its testing of scheduled messages to iOS
description: Earlier this month, WhatsApp started testing scheduled messages with some beta testers on Android, after the feature had been in development since at least February. Now it's making its way to iOS too, rolling out to some users of the WhatsApp beta for iOS version 26.42.10.19 from TestFlight, with more people set to get it over the coming weeks. It works the same way as on Android. Once you've typed your message, tap and hold the send button to bring up a date and time picker, then confirm with the green button at the bottom, which shows the exact delivery time. description: The iPhone Duo has been in very high demand since pre-orders started last week, with shipping dates slipping all the way to January within hours. Now, a new report claims Apple has responded by raising its iPhone Duo shipment target by 44%. title: Meta hit with $25B fine in New Mexico
description: The 2018 Cambridge Analytica scandal was one of the largest user data breaches in history and its repercussions for Meta are still felt to this day. Following a two-week trial, a jury in the State District Court in Santa Fe ruled that Meta had committed 43 million violations of New Mexico’s consumer protection laws. Each violation was assessed to carry up to $5,000 in penalty charges, leading to the $25 billion fine that Meta is now ordered to pay the state of New Mexico. This is the largest fine against the company to date. To put that number into perspective, Meta made an estimated $42.6...

title: Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold8 duo beats Fold7 sales by 45% in Europe, with a catch
description: Back in September, Samsung said that combined sales of the Galaxy Z Fold8 and Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra in Europe were 50% higher than those of the Galaxy Z Fold7 last year. Today, the company is back with an update that covers the first nine weeks of availability.
